columns.name: interviewer_email
columns.description: Used when interviewer is an external panelist not in the pod.

columns.name: feedback_sent_at
columns.description: When the Slack feedback DM went out (or null).

columns.name: meet_url
columns.description: Google Meet (or other video) URL created when this round was scheduled. Null for in-person rounds.

columns.name: calendar_event_id
columns.description: External calendar event id (Google Calendar) returned by schedule_screen, so we can update/cancel the event from the pod later.

columns.name: score
columns.description: AI-evaluated interview score on a 0–100 scale, written by evaluate_interview after the candidate completes an AI video interview. Null for human-led rounds (use the linked scorecards row for those).

columns.name: eval_path
columns.description: Pod-file path to the full evaluation JSON (per-question scores, strengths, concerns, proctor flags, transcript pointer). Written by evaluate_interview alongside the score.
